title: Sheh se Ali Akbar ka Janaza Na Uthega
body:
HAAYE AKBAR HAAYE AKBAR...(2)
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka..(2)lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
1) Qasim ko sada dijiye imdad ko aaye
Abbas ko dariya ki tarai se bulaye
Tuti hai kamar noore nazar uth nahi sakta
Har bar uthate hai magar uth nahi sakta
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
2) Sunte hai k dil thaam ke maa baith gayi hai
Akbar k kaleje me sina baith gayi hai
Rukti hui saansein hai labo pe ruki jaa'n hai
Seene se lahoo akbare mehroo k rawaa'n hai
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
3) Dar pe hai bahot der se ghabraye na zainab
Sar peet ke khaima se nikal aaye na zainab
Zainab ke to jeene ka sahara hai ye akbar
Farzando se apne unhe ye pyara hai akbar
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
4) Ye husn ye nana ki shabahat na milegi
Shabbir ko ye chaand si surat na milegi
Uthta nahi laila ki nishani ka janaza
Hai khaak pe ahmed ki jawani ka janaza
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
5) Gharwalo ki hai aankh ka taara mere maula
Zakhmi hai bahot gesuo wala mere maula
Phal barchi ka akbar ke jo seene me gada hai
Be jaan dulara tera reri pe pada hai
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
6) Kis tarah se ghar tak inhe le jaenge hazrat
Chalne me qadam aapke tharraenge hazrat
Jab lash na uth paegi humshakle nabi ki
Yaad aaegi hazrat ko alamdare jari ki
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
7) Is zakhm ko seene ke chhupa lijiye aaqa
Lakar koi chadar hi udhaa dijiye aqaa
Dewdi pe jawaa'n sher ka lasha jo pada hai
Khaimo me "RAZA" matame akbar ki sada hai
Piree me jawaa'n laal ka lasha na uthega
Sheh se ali akbar ka janaza na uthega..(2)
